The platform is designed to simplify backend workflow orchestration.

about_short_description.short_description: Trigger.dev provides a developer platform for building and managing background jobs and workflows in web applications.

product.name: Trigger.dev Background Jobs & AI Infrastructure
product.description: A platform for writing and running background jobs and AI workflows using normal async code, with automatic scaling, retries, and observability, without managing infrastructure.

product.name: Trigger.dev AI Task Orchestration
product.description: A system to build and run AI workflows by chaining prompts, routing tasks to AI models, parallelizing execution, and coordinating multiple AI agents.

product.name: Trigger.dev Realtime API and Streams
product.description: An API and system to stream real-time task status and LLM responses to frontends, enabling live updates and interactive AI agents.

product.name: Trigger.dev Build Extensions
product.description: A feature set allowing customization of the build process by adding system packages, binaries, and custom tooling to support specific project requirements.

product.name: Trigger.dev Self-Hosting
product.description: An open-source version of Trigger.dev that can be self-hosted, allowing users to deploy and manage the platform on their own infrastructure.
